title: Cost-effectiveness, ICER, and net monetary benefit
primary_chapter_title: Economic Evaluation, Affordability, and Health Technology Assessment
purpose: Compares an AI-enabled pathway with a comparator using incremental cost, incremental effect, ICER, net monetary benefit, and dominance rules.
input: `Strategies` sheet with strategy, cost per patient, effect per patient, and optional subgroup; `Parameters` sheet with willingness-to-pay threshold and eligible population.
outputs: Incremental-analysis table, ICER and NMB summary, cost-effectiveness plane, threshold comparison, and decision interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
